summary: End-to-end frontend testing of NAMAN UPPER dispatch redesign, branded print slips, blank QC slip, Cancel Plan, and new Production tabs. All 7 features verified against the review request. Seed script (/app/tests/seed_flow.py) drove 2 FINISHED plans + 1 QC plan + 1 PLANNED plan via API; then Playwright drove the Dispatch → Print → Cancel → Production-tabs flow. Backend also spot-checked (RM MATERIAL_RETURN on cancel of a CUTTING plan yields 5 return rows).

issues: Date column still shows time ('9/22/2026, 12:00:15 PM') — the print slip correctly hides time, but the list view is inconsistent with the 'date only' request. Cosmetic — not blocking.
Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Same class of warning noted in prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Format Dispatch list Date column as toLocaleDateString() only (drop time) to match the print slip and spec.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Cancel Plan Dialog (and other Radix dialogs) to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: DispatchNew.jsx togglePlan re-fetches /available-bags on every toggle but resets selectedBags — reasonable UX, but if a user reselects the same plan they lose their bag picks. Consider preserving selection or warning.
PrintDispatch renders a `.plan-block` per selected plan — layout is clean; article/colour/config header inline is a nice touch.
PlanDetail line 194 correctly uses bags.length for TOTAL BAGS — matches spec.
server.py cancel_plan (line 1185) correctly reverses cutting deductions with MATERIAL_RETURN rows, decrements plans_generated, records event, and blocks CANCEL from CANCELLED/DISPATCHED states.

success_rate.backend: 100% (spot checks: seed flow all 200s; cancel-with-cutting produces 5 MATERIAL_RETURN rows and status=CANCELLED)
